# VRCStorage - Full API Reference

> Exhaustive endpoint reference for AI agents and tooling. Every route in VRCStorage, including authenticated, admin, and write endpoints. For a concise, LLM-friendly overview of public reads only, see [llms.txt](https://vrcstorage.lat/llms.txt). Machine-readable JSON: [https://vrcstorage.lat/api/docs](https://vrcstorage.lat/api/docs).

Base API URL: `https://vrcstorage.lat/api`. CDN: `https://cdn.vrcstorage.lat/{uuid}?res=[low|med|original]&format=[webp|png|gif|video]`. Rate-limit tiers: `strict` (1/60s), `login` (10/60s), `medium` (100/60s), `global` (500/60s) - configured in wrangler.jsonc and wired in src/http/rate-limits.ts. Auth: `public` (no session), `optional` (gated field), `auth` (sealed session cookie via requireAuth), `admin` (requireAdmin). Pagination and UUID/timestamp conventions are as in llms.txt.

## Site - Frontend pages and wiki

### `GET /wiki/:lang/:topic.md`

**Raw wiki markdown (static asset)** - Raw Markdown source for a wiki article, served from ASSETS (public/wiki/{lang}/{topic}.md). The frontend falls back to English when the localized file is missing.

- Auth: No auth | Rate limit: global | Visibility: public

**Parameters**

| Location | Name | Type | Required | Description |
| :------- | :--- | :--- | :------- | :---------- |
| path | `lang` | enum (cn/de/en/es/fr/it/jp/nl/pl/pt/ru/tr) | Yes | Locale code |
| path | `topic` | string | Yes | Article slug (e.g. "home", "poiyomi") |

**Response** - text/markdown - raw Markdown, or the SPA shell HTML when missing (fallback signal)


## Avatars - Avatar listing, search, detail, and mutation

### `GET /api/avatars`

**List avatars with faceted filtering** - Paginated avatar listing filtered by gender, size, type, platform, SDK, NSFW, feature flags, and author. Uses INNER JOIN avatar_meta - only avatars with metadata appear.

- Auth: No auth | Rate limit: global | Visibility: public

**Parameters**

| Location | Name | Type | Required | Description |
| :------- | :--- | :--- | :------- | :---------- |
| query | `page` | integer | No | Page number Default: `1`. |
| query | `limit` | integer (1..60) | No | Items per page Default: `24`. |
| query | `sort_by` | enum (created_at, download_count, title) | No | Sort field Default: `created_at`. |
| query | `sort_order` | enum (asc, desc) | No | Sort direction Default: `desc`. |
| query | `avatar_gender` | enum (male, female, androgynous, undefined, both) | No | Filter by gender |
| query | `avatar_size` | enum (tiny, small, medium, tall, giant) | No | Filter by size |
| query | `avatar_type` | enum (human, furry, anime, chibi, cartoon, semi-realistic, monster, fantasy, mecha, kemono, sci-fi, vtuber, other) | No | Filter by avatar type |
| query | `platform` | enum (pc, quest, cross) | No | Filter by platform |
| query | `sdk_version` | enum (sdk3, sdk2) | No | Filter by SDK |
| query | `is_nsfw` | enum (0, 1) | No | NSFW filter |
| query | `has_physbones` | enum (0, 1) | No | Has PhysBones |
| query | `has_face_tracking` | enum (0, 1) | No | Has face tracking |
| query | `has_dps` | enum (0, 1) | No | Has DPS |
| query | `has_gogoloco` | enum (0, 1) | No | Has GoGo Loco |
| query | `has_toggles` | enum (0, 1) | No | Has toggles |
| query | `is_quest_optimized` | enum (0, 1) | No | Quest optimized |
| query | `author_uuid` | string (uuid v4) | No | Filter by author profile UUID |

**Response** - JSON - { resources: AvatarWithMeta[], pagination: { page, limit, total, hasNextPage, hasPrevPage } }

### `GET /api/avatars/search`

**Lightweight avatar name autocomplete** - Returns at most `limit` avatar titles matching a prefix - intended for the clothes base-avatar selector and similar autocomplete fields.

- Auth: No auth | Rate limit: global | Visibility: public

**Parameters**

| Location | Name | Type | Required | Description |
| :------- | :--- | :--- | :------- | :---------- |
| query | `q` | string (min 2 chars) | Yes | Partial avatar name to match |
| query | `limit` | integer (1..20) | No | Max results Default: `10`. |

**Response** - JSON - [{ uuid, title }]

### `GET /api/avatars/:uuid`

**Get a single avatar with metadata** - Full avatar detail including avatar_meta row. Used by HistoryView to compute diffs.

- Auth: No auth | Rate limit: global | Visibility: public

**Parameters**

| Location | Name | Type | Required | Description |
| :------- | :--- | :--- | :------- | :---------- |
| path | `uuid` | string (uuid v4) | Yes | Avatar resource UUID |

**Response** - JSON - AvatarWithMeta (resource + meta + links + media)

### `POST /api/avatars`

**Create an avatar resource** - Creates a resource, its avatar_meta row, links, and media relations in one batch. Created as inactive (pending approval). No history entry on creation.

- Auth: Auth required | Rate limit: medium | Visibility: private

**Parameters**

| Location | Name | Type | Required | Description |
| :------- | :--- | :--- | :------- | :---------- |
| body | `title` | string | Yes | Avatar title (3-100 chars) |
| body | `description` | string | No | Markdown description (<=8000 chars) |
| body | `category` | enum | Yes | Must be "avatars" |
| body | `thumbnail_uuid` | string (uuid v4) | Yes | Media UUID for the thumbnail |
| body | `reference_image_uuid` | string (uuid v4) | No | Optional reference image media UUID |
| body | `links` | array<LinkSchema> | No | Download/demo links |
| body | `media_files` | array<uuid> | No | Gallery media UUIDs |
| body | `meta` | object | Yes | AvatarMetaSchema payload (gender, size, type, platform, etc.) |
| query | `validate_only` | enum (true) | No | When "true", only validates without creating |

**Response** - 201 - { uuid }

### `PUT /api/avatars/:uuid`

**Edit avatar metadata (admin only)** - Snapshots previous avatar_meta, records a meta_edit in resource history, then updates. Requires admin.

- Auth: Admin only | Rate limit: medium | Visibility: private

**Parameters**

| Location | Name | Type | Required | Description |
| :------- | :--- | :--- | :------- | :---------- |
| path | `uuid` | string (uuid v4) | Yes | Avatar resource UUID |
| body | `meta fields` | object | No | Any AvatarMetaSchema field (partial) |

**Response** - JSON - { success: true }


## Assets - Asset listing and mutation

### `GET /api/assets`

**List assets with faceted filtering** - Paginated asset listing filtered by asset_type, platform, SDK, Unity version, and NSFW. INNER JOIN asset_meta.

- Auth: No auth | Rate limit: global | Visibility: public

**Parameters**

| Location | Name | Type | Required | Description |
| :------- | :--- | :--- | :------- | :---------- |
| query | `page` | integer | No | Page number Default: `1`. |
| query | `limit` | integer (1..60) | No | Items per page Default: `24`. |
| query | `sort_by` | enum (created_at, download_count, title) | No | Sort field Default: `created_at`. |
| query | `sort_order` | enum (asc, desc) | No | Sort direction Default: `desc`. |
| query | `asset_type` | enum (prop, shader, particle, vfx, prefab, script, animation, avatar-base, texture-pack, sound, tool, hud, other) | No | Filter by asset type |
| query | `platform` | enum (pc, quest, cross) | No | Filter by platform |
| query | `sdk_version` | enum (sdk3, sdk2) | No | Filter by SDK |
| query | `unity_version` | enum (2019, 2022) | No | Filter by Unity version |
| query | `is_nsfw` | enum (0, 1) | No | NSFW filter |

**Response** - JSON - { resources: AssetWithMeta[], pagination }

### `GET /api/assets/:uuid`

**Get a single asset with metadata** - Full asset detail including asset_meta row.

- Auth: No auth | Rate limit: global | Visibility: public

**Parameters**

| Location | Name | Type | Required | Description |
| :------- | :--- | :--- | :------- | :---------- |
| path | `uuid` | string (uuid v4) | Yes | Asset resource UUID |

**Response** - JSON - AssetWithMeta

### `POST /api/assets`

**Create an asset resource** - Creates a resource + asset_meta + links + media in one batch (inactive, pending approval).

- Auth: Auth required | Rate limit: medium | Visibility: private

**Parameters**

| Location | Name | Type | Required | Description |
| :------- | :--- | :--- | :------- | :---------- |
| body | `title` | string | Yes | Asset title |
| body | `thumbnail_uuid` | string | Yes | Media UUID for thumbnail |
| body | `meta` | object | Yes | AssetMetaSchema payload |

**Response** - 201 - { uuid }

### `PUT /api/assets/:uuid`

**Edit asset metadata (admin only)** - Snapshots previous state, records meta_edit, then updates. Requires admin.

- Auth: Admin only | Rate limit: medium | Visibility: private

**Parameters**

| Location | Name | Type | Required | Description |
| :------- | :--- | :--- | :------- | :---------- |
| path | `uuid` | string (uuid v4) | Yes | Asset resource UUID |

**Response** - JSON - { success: true }


## Clothes - Clothing listing and mutation

### `GET /api/clothes`

**List clothing items with faceted filtering** - Paginated clothes listing filtered by gender_fit, clothing_type, platform, is_base, is_nsfw, and has_physbones. INNER JOIN clothes_meta.

- Auth: No auth | Rate limit: global | Visibility: public

**Parameters**

| Location | Name | Type | Required | Description |
| :------- | :--- | :--- | :------- | :---------- |
| query | `page` | integer | No | Page number Default: `1`. |
| query | `limit` | integer (1..60) | No | Items per page Default: `24`. |
| query | `sort_by` | enum (created_at, download_count, title) | No | Sort field Default: `created_at`. |
| query | `sort_order` | enum (asc, desc) | No | Sort direction Default: `desc`. |
| query | `gender_fit` | enum (male, female, unisex, kemono) | No | Filter by gender fit |
| query | `clothing_type` | enum (top, jacket, bottom, dress, fullbody, swimwear, shoes, legwear, hat, hair, accessory, tail, ears, wings, body-part, underwear, other) | No | Filter by clothing type |
| query | `platform` | enum (pc, quest, cross) | No | Filter by platform |
| query | `is_base` | enum (0, 1) | No | Base avatar flag |
| query | `is_nsfw` | enum (0, 1) | No | NSFW filter |
| query | `has_physbones` | enum (0, 1) | No | Has PhysBones |
| query | `compatible_avatar` | string (uuid v4) | No | Filter by compatible avatar UUID |

**Response** - JSON - { resources: ClothesWithMeta[], pagination }

### `GET /api/clothes/:uuid`

**Get a single clothing item with metadata** - Full clothing detail including clothes_meta row.

- Auth: No auth | Rate limit: global | Visibility: public

**Parameters**

| Location | Name | Type | Required | Description |
| :------- | :--- | :--- | :------- | :---------- |
| path | `uuid` | string (uuid v4) | Yes | Clothes resource UUID |

**Response** - JSON - ClothesWithMeta

### `POST /api/clothes`

**Create a clothing resource** - Creates a resource + clothes_meta + links + media in one batch (inactive, pending approval).

- Auth: Auth required | Rate limit: medium | Visibility: private

**Parameters**

| Location | Name | Type | Required | Description |
| :------- | :--- | :--- | :------- | :---------- |
| body | `title` | string | Yes | Clothing title |
| body | `thumbnail_uuid` | string | Yes | Media UUID for thumbnail |
| body | `meta` | object | Yes | ClothesMetaSchema payload |

**Response** - 201 - { uuid }

### `PUT /api/clothes/:uuid`

**Edit clothing metadata (admin only)** - Snapshots previous state, records meta_edit, then updates. Requires admin.

- Auth: Admin only | Rate limit: medium | Visibility: private

**Parameters**

| Location | Name | Type | Required | Description |
| :------- | :--- | :--- | :------- | :---------- |
| path | `uuid` | string (uuid v4) | Yes | Clothes resource UUID |

**Response** - JSON - { success: true }


## Resources - Generic resource CRUD and links

### `GET /api/resources/latest`

**Latest active resources (KV-cached, 60s)** - Returns the 10 most recently created active resources, KV-cached for 60s with Cache-Control: public, max-age=60.

- Auth: No auth | Rate limit: global | Visibility: public

**Parameters**

No parameters.

**Response** - JSON - ResourceWithMedia[]

### `GET /api/resources`

**Search resources by query and category** - Paginated search across resources; optional category filter (avatars/assets/clothes/worlds) and sorting.

- Auth: No auth | Rate limit: global | Visibility: public

**Parameters**

| Location | Name | Type | Required | Description |
| :------- | :--- | :--- | :------- | :---------- |
| query | `page` | integer | No | Page number Default: `1`. |
| query | `limit` | integer (1..60) | No | Items per page Default: `30`. |
| query | `category` | enum (avatars, assets, clothes, worlds) | No | Resource category filter |
| query | `sort_by` | string | No | Sort field (legacy) |
| query | `sort_order` | enum (ASC, DESC) | No | Sort direction Default: `DESC`. |
| query | `q` | string | No | Free-text search (title/description) |

**Response** - JSON - { data: Resource[], pagination }

### `GET /api/resources/:uuid`

**Full resource detail (download links gated)** - Returns title, description (Markdown), thumbnail, reference image, gallery media, download links, metadata, and download_count. Download link URLs are only included for authenticated users.

- Auth: Optional auth (gated field) | Rate limit: global | Visibility: public

**Parameters**

| Location | Name | Type | Required | Description |
| :------- | :--- | :--- | :------- | :---------- |
| path | `uuid` | string (uuid v4) | Yes | Resource UUID |
| body | `auth` | cookie | No | Sealed session cookie (optional - unauthenticated users get the same resource without download links) |

**Response** - JSON - ResourceWithMedia & links & meta

> Note: Download links are filtered server-side when unauthenticated.

### `GET /api/resources/:uuid/history`

**Resource edit history** -  Chronological edit history for a resource. Requires authentication.

- Auth: Auth required | Rate limit: global | Visibility: private

**Parameters**

| Location | Name | Type | Required | Description |
| :------- | :--- | :--- | :------- | :---------- |
| path | `uuid` | string (uuid v4) | Yes | Resource UUID |

**Response** - JSON - ResourceHistoryWithActor[]

### `POST /api/resources`

**Create a generic resource** - Creates a new resource (pending approval). Turnstile CAPTCHA required.

- Auth: Auth required | Rate limit: strict | Visibility: private

**Parameters**

| Location | Name | Type | Required | Description |
| :------- | :--- | :--- | :------- | :---------- |
| body | `title` | string | Yes | Title (3-100 chars) |
| body | `category` | enum | Yes | Category |
| body | `thumbnail_uuid` | string | Yes | Thumbnail media UUID |
| body | `token` | string | No | Turnstile token |

**Response** - JSON - { success: true, uuid }

### `PUT /api/resources/:uuid`

**Update a resource (owner or admin)** - Owner or admin may update. Approved resources are admin-only for edits.

- Auth: Auth required | Rate limit: medium | Visibility: private

**Parameters**

| Location | Name | Type | Required | Description |
| :------- | :--- | :--- | :------- | :---------- |
| path | `uuid` | string (uuid v4) | Yes | Resource UUID |
| body | `title` | string | No | New title |
| body | `description` | string | No | New markdown description |
| body | `is_active` | integer | No | Active flag (0/1) |
| body | `new_links` | array<LinkSchema> | No | Additional links to append |
| body | `gallery_media_uuids` | array<uuid> | No | Replacement gallery UUIDs |

**Response** - JSON - { success: true }

### `DELETE /api/resources/:uuid`

**Delete a resource (admin only)** - Deletes the resource, its media rows, and R2 objects. Requires admin.

- Auth: Admin only | Rate limit: medium | Visibility: private

**Parameters**

| Location | Name | Type | Required | Description |
| :------- | :--- | :--- | :------- | :---------- |
| path | `uuid` | string (uuid v4) | Yes | Resource UUID |

**Response** - JSON - { success: true }

### `POST /api/resources/:uuid/links/reorder`

**Reorder download links** - Batch-reorders links for a resource. Must include every link UUID in the desired order. Owner or admin.

- Auth: Auth required | Rate limit: medium | Visibility: private

**Parameters**

| Location | Name | Type | Required | Description |
| :------- | :--- | :--- | :------- | :---------- |
| path | `uuid` | string (uuid v4) | Yes | Resource UUID |
| body | `ordered_uuids` | array<uuid (1..100)> | Yes | All link UUIDs in desired order |

**Response** - JSON - { ok: true }

### `DELETE /api/resources/:uuid/links/:linkUuid`

**Delete a single download link** - Deletes one link from a resource. Owner or admin.

- Auth: Auth required | Rate limit: medium | Visibility: private

**Parameters**

| Location | Name | Type | Required | Description |
| :------- | :--- | :--- | :------- | :---------- |
| path | `uuid` | string (uuid v4) | Yes | Resource UUID |
| path | `linkUuid` | string (uuid v4) | Yes | Link UUID |

**Response** - JSON - { ok: true }

### `PUT /api/resources/:uuid/links/:linkUuid`

**Update a single download link** - Updates title, URL, type, or display order for one link. Owner or admin.

- Auth: Auth required | Rate limit: medium | Visibility: private

**Parameters**

| Location | Name | Type | Required | Description |
| :------- | :--- | :--- | :------- | :---------- |
| path | `uuid` | string (uuid v4) | Yes | Resource UUID |
| path | `linkUuid` | string (uuid v4) | Yes | Link UUID |
| body | `link_url` | string | No | New URL (https:// or /) |
| body | `link_title` | string | No | New title |
| body | `link_type` | enum | No | Link type |

**Response** - JSON - { ok: true }


## Authors - Normalized avatar author profiles

### `GET /api/authors`

**List avatar authors (paginated)** - Paginated list of normalized avatar author profiles, each with resource_count.

- Auth: No auth | Rate limit: global | Visibility: public

**Parameters**

| Location | Name | Type | Required | Description |
| :------- | :--- | :--- | :------- | :---------- |
| query | `page` | integer | No | Page number Default: `1`. |
| query | `limit` | integer | No | Items per page Default: `24`. |

**Response** - JSON - { authors: AuthorWithCount[], pagination }

### `GET /api/authors/search`

**Author name autocomplete** - Prefix search over author names, max 10 results with uuid, name, slug.

- Auth: No auth | Rate limit: global | Visibility: public

**Parameters**

| Location | Name | Type | Required | Description |
| :------- | :--- | :--- | :------- | :---------- |
| query | `q` | string | Yes | Partial author name |
| query | `limit` | integer | No | Max results Default: `10`. |

**Response** - JSON - [{ uuid, name, slug }]

### `GET /api/authors/:slug`

**Author profile with avatars** - Public author profile plus paginated list of their published avatars.

- Auth: No auth | Rate limit: global | Visibility: public

**Parameters**

| Location | Name | Type | Required | Description |
| :------- | :--- | :--- | :------- | :---------- |
| path | `slug` | string (slug) | Yes | Author slug |
| query | `page` | integer | No | Page number Default: `1`. |
| query | `limit` | integer | No | Items per page Default: `12`. |

**Response** - JSON - { author, avatars: ResourceWithMedia[], pagination }

### `POST /api/authors`

**Create an author record (admin)** - Creates a normalized author profile. Service enforces admin role even though the route guard is requireAuth.

- Auth: Auth required | Rate limit: medium | Visibility: private

**Parameters**

| Location | Name | Type | Required | Description |
| :------- | :--- | :--- | :------- | :---------- |
| body | `name` | string | Yes | Author display name (1-70 chars) |
| body | `description` | string | No | Author bio (<=2000 chars) |
| body | `avatar_url` | string | No | Avatar image URL |

**Response** - 201 - Author

### `PUT /api/authors/:slug`

**Edit an author record (admin)** - Updates a normalized author profile. Admin-only (enforced in service).

- Auth: Auth required | Rate limit: medium | Visibility: private

**Parameters**

| Location | Name | Type | Required | Description |
| :------- | :--- | :--- | :------- | :---------- |
| path | `slug` | string (slug) | Yes | Author slug |

**Response** - JSON - { success: true }

### `DELETE /api/authors/:slug`

**Delete an author (admin, no linked avatars)** - Deletes an author only when no avatars are linked to it. Admin-only.

- Auth: Auth required | Rate limit: medium | Visibility: private

**Parameters**

| Location | Name | Type | Required | Description |
| :------- | :--- | :--- | :------- | :---------- |
| path | `slug` | string (slug) | Yes | Author slug |

**Response** - JSON - { success: true }

### `POST /api/authors/:slug/link-resource`

**Link an avatar to an author (admin)** - Links an avatar resource to an author. Records a meta_edit history snapshot. Admin-only.

- Auth: Auth required | Rate limit: medium | Visibility: private

**Parameters**

| Location | Name | Type | Required | Description |
| :------- | :--- | :--- | :------- | :---------- |
| path | `slug` | string (slug) | Yes | Author slug |
| body | `resource_uuid` | string (uuid v4) | Yes | Avatar resource UUID to link |

**Response** - JSON - { success: true }


## Blog - Blog posts and blog comments

### `GET /api/blog`

**List blog posts (paginated, KV-cached)** - Paginated blog post list with cover image key and author info. KV-cached for 1h (list) and per-post.

- Auth: No auth | Rate limit: global | Visibility: public

**Parameters**

| Location | Name | Type | Required | Description |
| :------- | :--- | :--- | :------- | :---------- |
| query | `page` | integer | No | Page number Default: `1`. |
| query | `limit` | integer (1..20) | No | Items per page Default: `10`. |

**Response** - JSON - { data: BlogPostWithAuthor[], pagination: { page, limit, total, total_pages } }

### `GET /api/blog/:uuid`

**Get a single blog post** - Single post by UUID, including full Markdown content.

- Auth: No auth | Rate limit: global | Visibility: public

**Parameters**

| Location | Name | Type | Required | Description |
| :------- | :--- | :--- | :------- | :---------- |
| path | `uuid` | string (uuid v4) | Yes | Blog post UUID |

**Response** - JSON - BlogPostWithAuthor

### `POST /api/blog`

**Create a blog post (admin)** - Creates a new blog post. Bumps the change_feed (blog scope) and broadcasts via FeedRoom.

- Auth: Admin only | Rate limit: medium | Visibility: private

**Parameters**

| Location | Name | Type | Required | Description |
| :------- | :--- | :--- | :------- | :---------- |
| body | `title` | string | Yes | Title (3-200 chars) |
| body | `content` | string | Yes | Markdown body (<=100k chars) |
| body | `excerpt` | string | No | Optional excerpt (<=500 chars) |
| body | `cover_image_uuid` | string (uuid v4) | No | Cover image media UUID |
| body | `author_display` | enum | No | Author display mode |

**Response** - 201 - { uuid, slug }

### `PUT /api/blog/:uuid`

**Update a blog post (admin)** - Partial update for a blog post. Admin-only.

- Auth: Admin only | Rate limit: medium | Visibility: private

**Parameters**

| Location | Name | Type | Required | Description |
| :------- | :--- | :--- | :------- | :---------- |
| path | `uuid` | string (uuid v4) | Yes | Blog post UUID |

**Response** - JSON - { success: true, uuid, slug }

### `DELETE /api/blog/:uuid`

**Delete a blog post (admin)** - Deletes a blog post and cleans up its cover image from R2.

- Auth: Admin only | Rate limit: medium | Visibility: private

**Parameters**

| Location | Name | Type | Required | Description |
| :------- | :--- | :--- | :------- | :---------- |
| path | `uuid` | string (uuid v4) | Yes | Blog post UUID |

**Response** - JSON - { success: true }

### `GET /api/blog/:uuid/comments`

**List comments for a blog post** - Comments for a single blog post, paginated.

- Auth: No auth | Rate limit: medium | Visibility: public

**Parameters**

| Location | Name | Type | Required | Description |
| :------- | :--- | :--- | :------- | :---------- |
| path | `uuid` | string (uuid v4) | Yes | Blog post UUID |
| query | `limit` | integer (1..50) | No | Max comments Default: `50`. |
| query | `offset` | integer | No | Offset Default: `0`. |

**Response** - JSON - BlogCommentWithAuthor[]

### `POST /api/blog/:uuid/comments`

**Add a comment to a blog post** - Creates a comment on a blog post. Turnstile-gated.

- Auth: Auth required | Rate limit: strict | Visibility: private

**Parameters**

| Location | Name | Type | Required | Description |
| :------- | :--- | :--- | :------- | :---------- |
| path | `uuid` | string (uuid v4) | Yes | Blog post UUID |
| body | `text` | string | Yes | Comment text (3-1000 chars) |
| body | `token` | string | No | Turnstile token |

**Response** - 201 - BlogComment

### `DELETE /api/blog/comments/:commentId`

**Delete a blog comment** - Deletes a blog comment. Author or admin only.

- Auth: Auth required | Rate limit: medium | Visibility: private

**Parameters**

| Location | Name | Type | Required | Description |
| :------- | :--- | :--- | :------- | :---------- |
| path | `commentId` | string (uuid v4) | Yes | Comment UUID |

**Response** - JSON - { success: true }


## Comments - Resource and wiki comments

### `GET /api/comments/:resourceId`

**List comments for a resource** - All comments for a given resource, with author info.

- Auth: No auth | Rate limit: medium | Visibility: public

**Parameters**

| Location | Name | Type | Required | Description |
| :------- | :--- | :--- | :------- | :---------- |
| path | `resourceId` | string (uuid v4) | Yes | Resource UUID |

**Response** - JSON - CommentWithAuthor[]

### `POST /api/comments/:resourceId`

**Create a comment on a resource** - Creates a comment on a resource. Turnstile-gated. Bumps the comments scope.

- Auth: Auth required | Rate limit: strict | Visibility: private

**Parameters**

| Location | Name | Type | Required | Description |
| :------- | :--- | :--- | :------- | :---------- |
| path | `resourceId` | string (uuid v4) | Yes | Resource UUID |
| body | `text` | string | Yes | Comment text (3-500 chars) |
| body | `token` | string | No | Turnstile token |

**Response** - 201 - Comment

### `DELETE /api/comments/:commentId`

**Delete a resource comment** - Deletes a resource comment. Author or admin only.

- Auth: Auth required | Rate limit: medium | Visibility: private

**Parameters**

| Location | Name | Type | Required | Description |
| :------- | :--- | :--- | :------- | :---------- |
| path | `commentId` | string (uuid v4) | Yes | Comment UUID |

**Response** - JSON - { success: true }

## Uploads - Single-shot and multipart file uploads

### `PUT /api/upload`

**Single-shot file upload** - Uploads a file (multipart/form-data, field "file"). Validates magic bytes, stores to R2 under the media UUID, inserts a media row, and enqueues post-processing via UPLOAD_QUEUE.

- Auth: Auth required | Rate limit: medium | Visibility: private

**Parameters**

| Location | Name | Type | Required | Description |
| :------- | :--- | :--- | :------- | :---------- |
| body | `file` | File (image <=20MB, video <=100MB, archive <=1500MB) | Yes | File to upload (multipart/form-data) |

**Response** - JSON - { media_uuid, r2_key, media_type, file_name }

### `POST /api/upload/init`

**Initialize a multipart upload** - Begins a large-file multipart upload. Stores expected media_type in KV for signature validation on part 1.

- Auth: Auth required | Rate limit: medium | Visibility: private

**Parameters**

| Location | Name | Type | Required | Description |
| :------- | :--- | :--- | :------- | :---------- |
| body | `filename` | string | Yes | Original filename |
| body | `media_type` | enum | Yes | Expected type for signature check |

**Response** - JSON - { uploadId, key } where key is the future media UUID

### `PUT /api/upload/part`

**Upload one part of a multipart upload** - Uploads a single chunk. Part 1 is magic-byte checked against the media_type declared at init. Uses R2 multipart upload under the hood.

- Auth: Auth required | Rate limit: medium | Visibility: private

**Parameters**

| Location | Name | Type | Required | Description |
| :------- | :--- | :--- | :------- | :---------- |
| header | `X-Upload-ID` | string | Yes | Multipart upload ID from /init |
| header | `X-Key` | string | Yes | Object key (media UUID) from /init |
| header | `X-Part-Number` | integer | Yes | 1-indexed part number |
| body | `body` | ReadableStream \| ArrayBuffer | Yes | Raw chunk bytes |

**Response** - JSON - R2 UploadedPart { partNumber, etag }

### `POST /api/upload/complete`

**Complete a multipart upload** - Finalizes a multipart upload. media_type is read from KV (server-authoritative), not the client body. Inserts the media row.

- Auth: Auth required | Rate limit: medium | Visibility: private

**Parameters**

| Location | Name | Type | Required | Description |
| :------- | :--- | :--- | :------- | :---------- |
| body | `key` | string | Yes | Object key (media UUID) |
| body | `uploadId` | string | Yes | Multipart upload ID |
| body | `parts` | array | Yes | Array of { partNumber, etag } from /part |
| body | `filename` | string | Yes | Original filename |

**Response** - JSON - { media_uuid, r2_key, media_type, file_name }


## Media - Media processing status and CDN variants

### `GET /api/media/:uuid/status`

**Media processing status** - Whether a media item has finished processing (its CDN variants exist). Derived from media_variants existence.

- Auth: No auth | Rate limit: global | Visibility: public

**Parameters**

| Location | Name | Type | Required | Description |
| :------- | :--- | :--- | :------- | :---------- |
| path | `uuid` | string (uuid v4) | Yes | Media UUID |

**Response** - JSON - { processed: boolean }


## Downloads - R2 file serving and CDN media variants

### `GET /api/download/:key`

**Download a private R2 file** - Proxies a private file (usually an archive like .zip/.rar/.blend) from the vrcstorage R2 bucket. Requires authentication - anonymous users receive 401. Sets Content-Type from the stored object.

- Auth: Auth required | Rate limit: global | Visibility: private

**Parameters**

| Location | Name | Type | Required | Description |
| :------- | :--- | :--- | :------- | :---------- |
| path | `key` | string (r2 key) | Yes | R2 object key (== media UUID) |

**Response** - Binary - raw file with Content-Type / Content-Disposition headers

### `GET https://cdn.vrcstorage.lat/:uuid`

**CDN - public media variants** - Standalone CDN Worker (src/cdn-worker.ts, wrangler-cdn.jsonc). Serves pre-processed public media from MEDIA_BUCKET. While the queue is still processing, serves a localized cover-safe placeholder (processing.{lang}.webp) with Cache-Control: no-store.

- Auth: No auth | Rate limit: global catch-all | Visibility: public

**Parameters**

| Location | Name | Type | Required | Description |
| :------- | :--- | :--- | :------- | :---------- |
| path | `uuid` | string (uuid v4) | Yes | Media UUID |
| query | `res` | enum (low, med, original) | No | Resolution variant Default: `med`. |
| query | `format` | enum (webp, png, gif, video) | No | Output format Default: `webp`. |

**Response** - Binary - image (webp/png/gif) or video (mp4, Range-supported) with long immutable cache

> Note: Images: 6 variants per media (low/med/original x webp/png); videos: {uuid}/video.mp4 + {uuid}/original.gif poster. Range requests are forwarded for video so <video> can seek.


## Favorites - User favorites and favorite ordering

### `GET /api/favorites`

**List favorites for the authenticated user** - Returns the caller's favorites, optionally scoped to a collection, with resource and author info. Sorted by display_order.

- Auth: Auth required | Rate limit: medium | Visibility: private

**Parameters**

| Location | Name | Type | Required | Description |
| :------- | :--- | :--- | :------- | :---------- |
| query | `collection_uuid` | string (uuid v4 \| null) | No | Collection UUID or null for uncategorized |
| query | `page` | integer | No | Page number Default: `1`. |
| query | `limit` | integer | No | Items per page Default: `24`. |

**Response** - JSON - UserFavoriteWithResource[] with pagination

### `GET /api/favorites/ids`

**List only favorite resource UUIDs** - Returns just the UUIDs of the caller's favorites. Anonymous users receive an empty list (not 401), so the frontend can hydrate favorite state before login.

- Auth: Optional auth (gated field) | Rate limit: medium | Visibility: private

**Parameters**

No parameters.

**Response** - JSON - string[] (resource UUIDs)

### `GET /api/favorites/check/:resourceUuid`

**Check if a resource is favorited** - Whether the caller has favorited a given resource. Anonymous -> { is_favorite: false } (not 401).

- Auth: Optional auth (gated field) | Rate limit: medium | Visibility: private

**Parameters**

| Location | Name | Type | Required | Description |
| :------- | :--- | :--- | :------- | :---------- |
| path | `resourceUuid` | string (uuid v4) | Yes | Resource UUID to check |

**Response** - JSON - { is_favorite: boolean }

### `POST /api/favorites`

**Add a resource to favorites** - Adds a resource to the caller's favorites, optionally into a specific collection.

- Auth: Auth required | Rate limit: medium | Visibility: private

**Parameters**

| Location | Name | Type | Required | Description |
| :------- | :--- | :--- | :------- | :---------- |
| body | `resource_uuid` | string (uuid v4) | Yes | Resource UUID to favorite |
| body | `collection_uuid` | string (uuid v4) | No | Target collection UUID |

**Response** - JSON - { success: true }

### `POST /api/favorites/reorder`

**Reorder favorites within a collection** - Batch-reorders favorites. The ordered_uuids array must contain every favorite in the target scope in the desired order.

- Auth: Auth required | Rate limit: medium | Visibility: private

**Parameters**

| Location | Name | Type | Required | Description |
| :------- | :--- | :--- | :------- | :---------- |
| body | `ordered_uuids` | array<uuid (<=500)> | Yes | All favorite resource UUIDs in desired order |
| body | `collection_uuid` | string (uuid \| "all" \| null) | Yes | Target scope: collection UUID, null (uncategorized), or "all" (global order) |

**Response** - JSON - { success: true }

### `PUT /api/favorites/:resourceUuid/collection`

**Move a favorite to a different collection** - Moves a single favorite to a different collection, or to uncategorized when collection_uuid is null.

- Auth: Auth required | Rate limit: medium | Visibility: private

**Parameters**

| Location | Name | Type | Required | Description |
| :------- | :--- | :--- | :------- | :---------- |
| path | `resourceUuid` | string (uuid v4) | Yes | Favorited resource UUID |
| body | `collection_uuid` | string (uuid v4 \| null) | Yes | Destination collection UUID (null -> uncategorized) |

**Response** - JSON - { success: true }

### `DELETE /api/favorites/:resourceUuid`

**Remove a resource from favorites** - Removes a single resource from the caller's favorites.

- Auth: Auth required | Rate limit: medium | Visibility: private

**Parameters**

| Location | Name | Type | Required | Description |
| :------- | :--- | :--- | :------- | :---------- |
| path | `resourceUuid` | string (uuid v4) | Yes | Favorited resource UUID |

**Response** - JSON - { success: true }

## Auth - Registration, login, profile, and sessions

### `POST /api/auth/register`

**Register a new user** - Creates a new user account. Turnstile CAPTCHA required.

- Auth: No auth | Rate limit: strict | Visibility: private

**Parameters**

| Location | Name | Type | Required | Description |
| :------- | :--- | :--- | :------- | :---------- |
| body | `username` | string | Yes | Username (3-32 chars, alphanumeric+_) |
| body | `password` | string | Yes | Password (8-100 chars) |
| body | `token` | string | No | Turnstile token |

**Response** - 201 - AuthResponse { token, user } + sets sealed session cookie

### `POST /api/auth/login`

**Login** - Authenticates a user. When 2FA is enabled, returns a pre_auth_token instead of a session - the client must call POST /api/auth/login/2fa to complete login.

- Auth: No auth | Rate limit: login | Visibility: private

**Parameters**

| Location | Name | Type | Required | Description |
| :------- | :--- | :--- | :------- | :---------- |
| body | `username` | string | Yes | Username |
| body | `password` | string | Yes | Password |
| body | `token` | string | No | Turnstile token |

**Response** - JSON - { token, user } or { pre_auth_token, requires_2fa: true }

### `POST /api/auth/login/2fa`

**Complete 2FA login** - Verifies a TOTP/backup code using the pre_auth_token from /login and creates the sealed session.

- Auth: No auth | Rate limit: login | Visibility: private

**Parameters**

| Location | Name | Type | Required | Description |
| :------- | :--- | :--- | :------- | :---------- |
| body | `username` | string | Yes | Username |
| body | `code` | string | Yes | 6-digit TOTP or backup code |
| body | `pre_auth_token` | string (uuid v4) | Yes | Pre-auth UUID from /login |

**Response** - JSON - { token, user } + sets session cookie

### `GET /api/auth/status`

**Check auth status** - Returns whether the caller is authenticated and, when logged in, their user object.

- Auth: No auth | Rate limit: global | Visibility: private

**Parameters**

No parameters.

**Response** - JSON - { authenticated: boolean, user?: User }

### `POST /api/auth/logout`

**Logout** - Clears the sealed session cookie and invalidates the KV session entry.

- Auth: No auth | Rate limit: global | Visibility: private

**Parameters**

No parameters.

**Response** - JSON - { success: true }

### `PUT /api/auth/me`

**Update own profile** - Updates the caller's username, avatar_url, or anonymity flag. Turnstile may be required.

- Auth: Optional auth (gated field) | Rate limit: medium | Visibility: private

**Parameters**

| Location | Name | Type | Required | Description |
| :------- | :--- | :--- | :------- | :---------- |
| body | `username` | string | No | New username (3-32 chars, alphanumeric+_) |
| body | `avatar_url` | string | No | New avatar URL (https:// or /) |
| body | `is_anonymous` | integer (0\|1) | No | Anonymity flag |

**Response** - JSON - { success: true, user }

### `POST /api/auth/me/password`

**Change own password** - Changes the caller's password. Requires current_password (unless OAuth-only account) and a valid 2FA code when 2FA is enabled.

- Auth: Optional auth (gated field) | Rate limit: medium | Visibility: private

**Parameters**

| Location | Name | Type | Required | Description |
| :------- | :--- | :--- | :------- | :---------- |
| body | `current_password` | string | No | Current password |
| body | `new_password` | string | Yes | New password (8-200 chars) |
| body | `two_factor_code` | string | No | TOTP/backup code when 2FA is enabled |

**Response** - JSON - { success: true }


## OAuth - Google OAuth flow

### `GET /api/auth/google`

**Start Google OAuth** - Redirects the user to Google's OAuth consent screen. Used to link or sign in via Google.

- Auth: No auth | Rate limit: medium | Visibility: private

**Parameters**

No parameters.

**Response** - 302 - Redirect to Google consent URL

### `GET /api/auth/google/callback`

**Google OAuth callback** - Google redirects here after consent. Exchanges the code, verifies the id_token, and either creates a session or stores a pending registration in KV and redirects to the OAuthRegisterView.

- Auth: No auth | Rate limit: medium | Visibility: private

**Parameters**

| Location | Name | Type | Required | Description |
| :------- | :--- | :--- | :------- | :---------- |
| query | `code` | string | Yes | Authorization code from Google |
| query | `state` | string | No | Opaque state param |

**Response** - 302 - Redirect to /oauth-register (pending) or / (existing user) + sets session cookie

### `POST /api/auth/complete`

**Complete OAuth registration** - Called by OAuthRegisterView after the user picks a username for a pending Google registration.

- Auth: No auth | Rate limit: strict | Visibility: private

**Parameters**

| Location | Name | Type | Required | Description |
| :------- | :--- | :--- | :------- | :---------- |
| body | `username` | string | Yes | Chosen username (3-32 chars) |
| body | `pending_token` | string | No | Pending registration token from callback step |

**Response** - 201 - { token, user } + sets session cookie


## Two-Factor - TOTP two-factor authentication

### `POST /api/2fa/setup`

**Begin 2FA setup** - Generates a TOTP secret and an otpauth:// URL + QR code for the caller. The secret is not yet active until /2fa/verify.

- Auth: Auth required | Rate limit: medium | Visibility: private

**Parameters**

| Location | Name | Type | Required | Description |
| :------- | :--- | :--- | :------- | :---------- |
| body | `password` | string | No | Current password (re-auth) |

**Response** - JSON - { secret, otpauth_url, qr_data_url }

### `POST /api/2fa/verify`

**Verify TOTP and enable 2FA** - Verifies the 6-digit TOTP code against the pending secret, enables 2FA, and returns one-time backup codes.

- Auth: Auth required | Rate limit: medium | Visibility: private

**Parameters**

| Location | Name | Type | Required | Description |
| :------- | :--- | :--- | :------- | :---------- |
| body | `code` | string | Yes | 6-digit TOTP code |

**Response** - JSON - { backup_codes: string[] }

### `POST /api/2fa/disable`

**Disable 2FA** - Disables 2FA for the caller. Requires password or valid TOTP/backup code.

- Auth: Auth required | Rate limit: medium | Visibility: private

**Parameters**

| Location | Name | Type | Required | Description |
| :------- | :--- | :--- | :------- | :---------- |
| body | `password` | string | No | Current password |
| body | `code` | string | No | TOTP or backup code |

**Response** - JSON - { success: true }

### `GET /api/2fa/status`

**Get 2FA status** - Whether 2FA is enabled for the caller.

- Auth: Auth required | Rate limit: medium | Visibility: private

**Parameters**

No parameters.

**Response** - JSON - { enabled: boolean }


## Admin - Moderation, stats, and maintenance (admin-only)

### `GET /api/admin/pending`

**List pending (inactive) resources** - All inactive resources awaiting moderation, with author and media info.

- Auth: Admin only | Rate limit: medium | Visibility: internal

**Parameters**

No parameters.

**Response** - JSON - ResourceWithMedia[]

### `POST /api/admin/resource/:uuid/approve`

**Approve a pending resource** - Flips is_active to 1, invalidates caches, bumps the change_feed for the resource's category scope, and broadcasts via FeedRoom.

- Auth: Admin only | Rate limit: medium | Visibility: internal

**Parameters**

| Location | Name | Type | Required | Description |
| :------- | :--- | :--- | :------- | :---------- |
| path | `uuid` | string (uuid v4) | Yes | Resource UUID to approve |

**Response** - JSON - { success: true }

### `POST /api/admin/resource/:uuid/reject`

**Reject and delete a pending resource** - Deletes the resource and its R2 objects/media rows. Only pending (inactive) resources can be rejected.

- Auth: Admin only | Rate limit: medium | Visibility: internal

**Parameters**

| Location | Name | Type | Required | Description |
| :------- | :--- | :--- | :------- | :---------- |
| path | `uuid` | string (uuid v4) | Yes | Resource UUID to reject |

**Response** - JSON - { success: true }

### `POST /api/admin/resource/:uuid/deactivate`

**Deactivate an approved resource** - Flips an approved resource back to inactive and invalidates caches.

- Auth: Admin only | Rate limit: medium | Visibility: internal

**Parameters**

| Location | Name | Type | Required | Description |
| :------- | :--- | :--- | :------- | :---------- |
| path | `uuid` | string (uuid v4) | Yes | Resource UUID to deactivate |

**Response** - JSON - { success: true }

### `GET /api/admin/stats/orphaned-media`

**Orphaned-media stats (no deletion)** - Counts orphaned media inside the 24h-48h age window (same predicate the cron uses). No files are deleted.

- Auth: Admin only | Rate limit: medium | Visibility: internal

**Parameters**

No parameters.

**Response** - JSON - { count, totalSize, oldestTimestamp }

### `POST /api/admin/cleanup/orphaned-media`

**Delete orphaned media (R2 + DB)** - Deletes orphaned media inside the 24h-48h window: variant objects from MEDIA_BUCKET, original from BUCKET, then media row (cascades to media_variants). Reuses the same logic as the daily cron.

- Auth: Admin only | Rate limit: medium | Visibility: internal

**Parameters**

No parameters.

**Response** - JSON - { success: true, deleted, message }

### `POST /api/admin/cache/clear/:username`

**Clear KV session cache for a user** - Deletes user:<username> from KV - useful after role changes to force re-resolution.

- Auth: Admin only | Rate limit: medium | Visibility: internal

**Parameters**

| Location | Name | Type | Required | Description |
| :------- | :--- | :--- | :------- | :---------- |
| path | `username` | string | Yes | Target username |

**Response** - JSON - { success: true, message }

### `POST /api/admin/users/:username/role`

**Set a user's admin flag** - Updates is_admin for a target user and immediately invalidates their KV cache so a demoted admin cannot retain elevated access for up to 7 days.

- Auth: Admin only | Rate limit: medium | Visibility: internal

**Parameters**

| Location | Name | Type | Required | Description |
| :------- | :--- | :--- | :------- | :---------- |
| path | `username` | string | Yes | Target username |
| body | `is_admin` | integer (0\|1) | Yes | New admin flag (0 or 1) |

**Response** - JSON - { success: true, username, is_admin }

### `GET /api/admin/stats`

**Dashboard aggregate stats** - Consolidated metrics for the admin dashboard overview section (resource counts, user counts, pending count, etc.).

- Auth: Admin only | Rate limit: medium | Visibility: internal

**Parameters**

No parameters.

**Response** - JSON - AdminStats { totalResources, pendingResources, totalUsers, ... }

### `GET /api/admin/users`

**List users (paginated, searchable)** - Paginated user listing with optional username prefix search.

- Auth: Admin only | Rate limit: medium | Visibility: internal

**Parameters**

| Location | Name | Type | Required | Description |
| :------- | :--- | :--- | :------- | :---------- |
| query | `q` | string | No | Username search prefix |
| query | `page` | integer | No | Page number Default: `1`. |

**Response** - JSON - { users, pagination }

### `GET /api/admin/resources`

**List all resources (filterable)** - All resources (active + pending) with optional category/status/text filters.

- Auth: Admin only | Rate limit: medium | Visibility: internal

**Parameters**

| Location | Name | Type | Required | Description |
| :------- | :--- | :--- | :------- | :---------- |
| query | `q` | string | No | Title search |
| query | `category` | enum (avatars, assets, clothes, worlds) | No | Category filter |
| query | `status` | enum (active, pending) | No | Active filter |
| query | `page` | integer | No | Page number Default: `1`. |

**Response** - JSON - { resources, pagination }

### `POST /api/admin/media/generate-variants`

**Backfill image variants (enqueue)** - Enqueues UPLOAD_QUEUE messages for every image/video that has no variants yet, so the queue handler regenerates them.

- Auth: Admin only | Rate limit: medium | Visibility: internal

**Parameters**

No parameters.

**Response** - JSON - { enqueued: number }

### `POST /api/admin/media/unify-keys`

**One-off: unify media R2 keys to UUIDs** - Maintenance migration - copies each original in BUCKET to the key equal to its UUID, rewrites free-text references, repoints the media.r2_key column, then deletes the old object. Defaults to a dry-run; pass ?confirm=true to execute. Idempotent and re-runnable with ?limit=N per pass.

- Auth: Admin only | Rate limit: medium | Visibility: internal

**Parameters**

| Location | Name | Type | Required | Description |
| :------- | :--- | :--- | :------- | :---------- |
| query | `confirm` | enum (true) | No | When "true", performs writes; otherwise dry-run |
| query | `limit` | integer | No | Max rows per pass (Worker CPU budget) |

**Response** - JSON - { dryRun, processed, remaining, textReferences }


## System - Configuration and version metadata

### `GET /api/config`

- Auth: No auth | Rate limit: global | Visibility: public

**Parameters**

No parameters.

**Response** - JSON - { turnstileSiteKey }

### `GET /api/version`

**Worker version and request metadata** - Unauthenticated deployment metadata: version ID/tag, commit hash, compatibility date, Cloudflare Ray/colo/country. Intentionally public for debugging.

- Auth: No auth | Rate limit: global | Visibility: public

**Parameters**

No parameters.

**Response** - JSON - { worker: { versionId, versionTag, commitHash, deployedAt, compatibilityDate }, runtime, request: { rayId, colo, country } }


## Realtime - Live feed, polling updates, global chat, and notifications

### `GET /api/updates`

**Polling change feed (fallback for live feed)** - Returns the server clock and the newest change timestamp per scope (avatars/assets/clothes/blog/comments) since ?since. The frontend polls this when the live WebSocket is down. Scopes map to DataCache prefixes the client invalidates.

- Auth: No auth | Rate limit: global | Visibility: public

**Parameters**

| Location | Name | Type | Required | Description |
| :------- | :--- | :--- | :------- | :---------- |
| query | `since` | integer (unix ms) | Yes | Cursor in Unix ms (0 for full) |

**Response** - JSON - { now, changes: { avatars, assets, clothes, blog, comments } }

### `GET /api/feed/live`

**Live feed WebSocket** - Upgrades to a WebSocket backed by the global FeedRoom Durable Object. Broadcasts FeedEvent { scope, action, entityId, title?, category?, thumbnailUuid?, isNsfw? } in real time. When open, the frontend suspends the /api/updates poller; when it drops, the poller resumes and covers the gap. Same reconciler drives both paths.

- Auth: No auth | Rate limit: medium | Visibility: public

**Parameters**

No parameters.

**Response** - 101 Switching Protocols - WebSocket frames are JSON FeedEvent objects

### `GET /api/chat/live`

**Global chat WebSocket** - Upgrades to a WebSocket backed by the global ChatRoom Durable Object. Reading is public; only authenticated sockets may send. Text-only, <=50 chars, backlog of 50 messages. The route stamps X-Chat-User-Uuid/Username headers before forwarding to the DO - the client never supplies identity.

- Auth: Optional auth (gated field) | Rate limit: medium | Visibility: public

**Parameters**

No parameters.

**Response** - 101 - WebSocket. Client sends { type: "send", text }; server emits { type: "history" | "message" | "purged" | "error", ... }

### `POST /api/chat/purge`

**Purge global chat (admin)** - Empties the ChatRoom history for everyone. Admin-only, rate-limited to 1/min (strict). HTTP (not a socket message) so the DO never reasons about roles.

- Auth: Admin only | Rate limit: strict | Visibility: internal

**Parameters**

No parameters.

**Response** - JSON - { success: true }

### `GET /api/notifications/preferences`

**Get notification preferences** - Returns the caller's browser Notification preferences (defaults when never saved).

- Auth: Auth required | Rate limit: medium | Visibility: private

**Parameters**

No parameters.

**Response** - JSON - NotificationPrefs { enabled, avatars_enabled, avatar_types, assets_enabled, asset_types, clothes_enabled, updated_at }

### `PUT /api/notifications/preferences`

**Save notification preferences** - Persists the caller's Notification preferences (which approved-resource scopes and avatar/asset sub-types should trigger a browser notification).

- Auth: Auth required | Rate limit: medium | Visibility: private

**Parameters**

| Location | Name | Type | Required | Description |
| :------- | :--- | :--- | :------- | :---------- |
| body | `enabled` | boolean | Yes | Master toggle |
| body | `avatars_enabled` | boolean | Yes | Notify for avatars |
| body | `avatar_types` | array<string> \| null | No | Which avatar types to notify |
| body | `assets_enabled` | boolean | Yes | Notify for assets |
| body | `asset_types` | array<string> \| null | No | Which asset types to notify |
| body | `clothes_enabled` | boolean | Yes | Notify for clothes |

**Response** - JSON - { success: true }

Generated from the single source of truth at `src/docs/registry.ts` (20 tags). To update the docs: edit that file and run `npm run docs:build` - /llms.txt and /llms-full.txt are static ASSETS (public/) rebuilt at deploy time, while /api/docs is served live from the same registry with optional ?tag= filtering. Run `npm run docs:check` locally to catch a route that exists without a doc entry.
